environment: local built Worker, local D1, synthetic data
limits: A smoke test: about 30 checks over the main paths, not the 4,599-assertion HTTP suite and not an acceptance test. No formal acceptance case is promoted by it.
One run of one built Worker (wrangler dev, local D1, synthetic data). It does not exercise the hosted Cloudflare deployment, real providers or a browser.
The visit flow uses the two demonstration destinations (simulator, no network): one answers "accepted" with a receipt, the other is the deliberate "uncertain" case. Nothing leaves the process.
The page check reads the server-rendered shell only. The sidebar environment banner is drawn by the browser after sign-in; the UI suite covers it.

checks.label: anonymous GET /api/workspace is refused: 401 with a sign-in message
anonymous POST /api/commands is refused: 401 with a sign-in message
a reserved fixture identity cannot sign in (401)
anonymous page request is redirected to sign-in (307), not served the application
page shell renders for a signed-in user: HTML, title, no-store, synthetic footer notice
a new owner gets a home organisation, owner membership and six synthetic people in the default team
the deployment is synthetic: workspace and /api/environment agree, external services off
the demonstration clinical package installed itself: 7 governance entries, all active, usable, no issues
the owner invites an ASHA and a supervisor by account code, and both join the same organisation
an invitation cannot be reused, and another account cannot use it (403)
the ASHA sees nobody until the owner assigns a person, then exactly that person
the ASHA cannot start a visit or read the history of a person who is not assigned (403)
the ASHA starts a visit: a draft, version 1, for the assigned person
saving blood pressure 152/114 with the other required facts stores them exactly (version 2, still a draft)
the clinical review gives the urgent danger-sign finding and routes it to the CHC/FRU
confirming needs the patient check: none is 422, a stale one is 409; the right one confirms the visit
the programme plan is prepared for both demonstration destinations, and cannot run before it is approved (409)
approving and running the plan sends to the demonstration destinations; receipts exist, the lost response is "uncertain"
running the plan again does not send again (still two submissions, one attempt each)
the owner's audit trail records the whole visit under the ASHA's role
the supervisor reads operations (aggregate, owner-only detail withheld) and sees the uncertain destination alert
the supervisor and the ASHA are refused owner-only commands (403) and nothing is created
a stranger is refused another organisation's workspace, patients, governance, FHIR and commands (403)
the stranger's own home organisation is separate: different id, six synthetic people, none of the owner's visits
all 40 GET routes in HTTP-ROUTES.csv refuse an anonymous caller (401)
every GET route in HTTP-ROUTES.csv answers the owner without a 5xx (200 wherever it can be called)
